{{Otheruseslist|十干十二支の丁卯|日本海軍軍艦もしくはChōshū Domainの丁卯丸|第一丁卯|もう一隻の日本海軍軍艦|第二丁卯}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Fire Rabbit''' (丁卯, ''hinoto usagi''; onyomi ''tei bō'') is the 4th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 4th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Fire Tiger|ja|丙寅}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Earth Dragon|ja|戊辰}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丁'' is Yin Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''卯'' (Rabbit) is Yin Wood; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Fire Rabbit (丁卯)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): dīngmǎo
** Cantonese (Jyutping): ding1 maau5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoto-usagi
*** On'yomi: teibō
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): jeongmyo (정묘)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Đinh Mão

==Months of Yin Fire Rabbit==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 4 or 9 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoto (己)|ja|己|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsu}}), the month of {{ill|February|en|February|qid=Q109|lt=February}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yin Fire Rabbit|ja|丁卯|qq=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Teibou}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Jingzhe|en|Jingzhe|qid=Q1306596|lt=Awakening of Insects}} until the day before {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}}) as applicable.
